decisive_feature: Recording a conversation with external parties without their consent is itself a breach of recording-consent obligations, a direct harm separate from the privacy intrusion.
why: The facts are read correctly, but recording external participants without established consent directly creates a legal/consent violation in addition to the privacy harm. That makes the two-label set better supported than privacy alone.
